name: book_recommendation
description: Book recommendation domain ontology for mystery/thriller/crime fiction

entity_types.name: BOOK
entity_types.description: A book or novel, identified by title

entity_types.name: GENRE
entity_types.description: A book genre, sub-genre, or shelf category

entity_types.name: PERSON
entity_types.description: A user or person mentioned in conversation

relation_types.name: PART_OF_SERIES
relation_types.description: Book is part of a series

relation_types.name: SIMILAR_TO
relation_types.description: Books are similar to each other

relation_types.name: PREFERS
relation_types.description: User prefers a genre or author

relation_types.name: WANTS_TO_READ
relation_types.description: User wants to read a book
